# PSAI fixture licence

Kind: reference.

The six screenshots under `vision_smoke/` and the rows in `metadata_smoke.jsonl`
come from the
[anaisleila/computer-use-data-psai](https://huggingface.co/datasets/anaisleila/computer-use-data-psai)
dataset, train split. The Hub revision on 2026-10-02 was
`0e1b7c63072833ba58b89dcfcc0cbac45107b0f4`. The commit the rows were taken from
is not recorded. The screenshots are the unmodified first screenshot of each
row that `vision_smoke/manifest.json` names. The metadata rows keep a subset of
the upstream columns. The values were not compared with upstream byte for byte.

own output (issues #192 and #180). They hold no upstream bytes and need no
upstream licence. A screenshot can show a third-party web page. The MIT
licence covers the dataset, not the rights of that page's owner.
